request.system: You are a strict claim verifier. You only trust the catalog facts given to you.
request.user:
Verify every factual claim in the campaign is grounded in the catalog facts. Fail if any claim is unsupported, exaggerated, or contradicts the facts.
Rules (from reviewer overrides):
- ANY mention of an out-of-stock product (stock 0) fails, whether or not the copy prompts purchase — no editorial exception.
- Numeric spec claims (lumens, hours, capacity, ratings) must match the catalog exactly; doubling or inflating a spec fails.
- Transferring an attribute from another product, or upgrading 'water-resistant' to 'waterproof', is a fabricated claim and fails.
- A comparative or superlative claim ('brightest', 'longest-lasting', 'most X') is scoped to the product type named in the claim and checked against the comparison set below: it fails if a same-type peer beats the subject on the compared attribute. Vague puffery ('great gear', 'toughest', 'best ever') with no measurable attribute is acceptable.
Catalog facts:
NB-JKT-07 Northbay Stormline Shell Jacket: attributes={'layers': 3, 'waterproof_rating_mm': 20000, 'breathability_gm2': 20000, 'weight_grams': 420, 'material': '3-layer laminate'} stock=12

Claims to verify:
- 20,000mm waterproof rating (NB-JKT-07 catalog spec)
- 20,000 g/m² breathability rating (NB-JKT-07 catalog spec)
- 3-layer laminate construction (NB-JKT-07 catalog spec)
- 420g weight (NB-JKT-07 catalog spec)
- 20% discount applies to NB-JKT-07 through Sunday

Body: If you've got a wet-weather trip on the calendar, the Stormline Shell (NB-JKT-07) is worth a look this week.

The specs, plainly:

• 20,000mm waterproof rating — keeps sustained rain out, not just a passing drizzle
• 20,000 g/m² breathability — moves moisture when you're working hard on the ascent
• 3-layer laminate construction — the face fabric, membrane, and backer are bonded together, which holds up better over time than a hanging liner
• 420g total weight — light enough to carry without thinking about it, substantial enough to wear as your primary layer in foul conditions

This jacket is built for sustained wet weather in the mountains. It's not a puffy, not an insulating layer — pair it with your own midlayer system underneath.

20% off runs through Sunday. After that, price returns to full retail.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.
